title: 熱流体工学
subtitle: Introduction to  Thermofluids
teachers:
HIROMITSU Nagayoshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will learn :
1. the energy exchange processes and systems
 (1)energy exchange processes and exergy
 (2)jet engines as thermodynamic cycle
2. the heat transfer process in machine element parts
  conduction, convection, radiation
advice:
This is a basic course on thermofluids.
We will cover the following materials:

 1. Lecture on engine system and principle of energy exchange process, exercises.
  (1)overview
  (2)energy exchange processes and exergy, exercises.
  (3)jet engine cycle and performance calculation, exercises.
 2. Lecture on basics of heat transfer
    Fourier law on heat conduction and application to simple models.
    non-dimensional parameter governing heat convection and application to simple models.

Students will also learn about advanced issues such as radiation.
Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas.
Students are expected to solve advanced exercises on their own.
Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of lectures, quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
books:

reserved books :"Hajimetemanabu idougenshouron",　Morikita Syuppan
requiredKnowledge:
Acquisition of Fluid Dynamics and Thermodynamics
Sufficient skill in mathematics (especially differential / integral calculations)
How to use a scientific calculator

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain basic concept of energy exchange.
Be able to explain jet engine and piston engine cycle calculations.
Be able to calculate basic heat conduction and heat convection.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Explain the concept of the energy exchange mechanism.
(2) On the basis of the concept of the energy exchange mechanism, formulate the calculation of actual engine performance.
(3) Explain the concept of heat transfer and formulate it correctly.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain the means of the energy exchange mechanism.
(2) Calculate engine performance using the formulated equations.
(3) Explain the meaning of heat transfer and calculate heat transfer using the formulated equations.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course on thermofluids.
We will cover the following materials:

 1. Lecture on engine system and principle of energy exchange process, exercises.
  (1)overview
  (2)energy exchange processes and exergy, exercises.
  (3)jet engine cycle and performance calculation, exercises.
 2. Lecture on basics of heat transfer
    Fourier law on heat conduction and application to simple models.
    non-dimensional parameter governing heat convection and application to simple models.

Students will also learn about advanced issues such as radiation.
Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas.
Students are expected to solve advanced exercises on their own.
Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of lectures, quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
